latest_release.name: World Monitor v2.11.8
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

- chore(release): bump desktop to 2.11.8 (#10150)
- perf(blog): self-host subset web fonts with a preloaded core and on-demand extended files (#10145)
- fix(panels): make table status and severity badges readable in both themes (#10144)
- fix(panels): make price and stock table state colours readable in both themes (#10143)
- fix(panels): collapse the badge and watchlist button in market headers up to 420px (#10142)
- feat(self-host): unlock Pro on self-hosted dashboards with the user's own desktop key (#10137)
- ci(deploy-gate): stop holding runners for waits and history the evaluation does not need (#10141)
- fix(panels): move the last inline-styled panel tables to the shared table style (#10131)
- ci(test): rebalance smoke shards and trim the built-output job (#10140)
- fix(panels): move the price, radiation and oil-stock tables to the shared table style (#10130)
- fix(energy): style the oil-stock badges and regional summary rows (#10132)
- chore(open-data): refresh chokepoint status snapshot 2026-11-04 (#10135)
- fix(styles): make blue semantic text readable in the light theme (#10133)
- fix(panels): move the energy, FX, ETF and watchlist tables to the shared table style (#10129)
- fix(panels): give panel tables one shared header and cell style (#10128)
- fix(styles): stop TypeScript styles reading undefined colour tokens (#10127)
- fix(panels): stop four panels scrolling sideways in narrow sidebar columns (#10126)
- perf(welcome): serve phones the 640w hero screenshot and preload it (#10136)
- fix(portwatch): retry ArcGIS's intermittent Invalid URL answers per page (#10134)
- fix(settings): cue the phone tab strip and keep the selected tab in view (#10117)
- fix(regional-intelligence): style the region picker like the dashboard's (#10116)
- fix(panels): stop wide panels adding sidebar columns the grid has no room for (#10119)
- fix(self-host): pin military-bases EVALs, add bind-host settings, send a User-Agent to Overpass (#10124)
- docs(solutions): GDACS F5 challenge answers browser User-Agents with HTML (#10123)
- fix(panels): give long header titles a second line and touch controls a 24px tap area (#10121)
- fix(hormuz): stretch the shipment bar charts to the panel body (#10120)
- fix(panels): keep prediction labels in their segment and wrap SEC filer names (#10115)
- fix(resilience): regenerate the docs date manifest before the refresh's data tests (#10118)
- feat(food-prices): read Thailand's daily farm prices from the NABC dashboard (#10109)
- fix(energy): keep disruptions log values whole and stack rows in narrow columns (#10107)
- fix(panels): keep panel header titles readable on phones and 375px columns (#10106)
- docs(intel-history): write the embedding-model migration runbook (#5742) (#9886)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/koala73/worldmonitor/compare/convex-deployed...v2.11.8
